source_qualification.scope: One controlled crossover report, PMID19421321, plus its linked supporting documents/current registry. Not a whole-glutamine review.

exact_prior_decision.route: Source-labelled glutamine / pediatric DMD strength-null comparator
exact_prior_decision.disposition: retain bounded administered-null comparison; no general glutamine inefficacy or BUB1B/MVA benefit established
exact_prior_decision.evidence_scope: Complete original PMID15984021 abstract and current linked NCT00016653 protocol read. Full scientific main, native figures/tables, supplements and numerical secondary/safety results not accessed. Same trial already covered for creatine, with zero extra study/outer credit.
exact_prior_decision.rationale: The six-month randomized double-blind CINRG trial administered glutamine0.6g/kg/day separately from creatine and placebo. Its abstract reports no significant primary manual/quantitative strength effect of either treatment, alongside qualitative tolerability. It does not establish the individual secondary timed-function or pulmonary results, and “cannot be excluded” subgroup language is not a proven benefit. The linked registry supports oral administration and a study-wide hot-cocoa/water-mixed preparation, but has enrollment48 versus publication50 and no posted results. Retain this real administered comparison without interpreting a nonsignificant result as proof of equivalence or extending it to other preparations/conditions.
exact_prior_decision.identity_limit: Source label glutamine does not specify stereochemistry, manufacturer, purity or product. Exact generic-name relation to CHEMBL930 and NIH DSLD75 is not verification of the catalog’s stereodefined L-glutamine preparation or availability; no L-glutamine/product aliases proposed.

source.title: Lack of functional benefit with glutamine versus placebo in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: a randomized crossover trial.

discovery.selection: Predeclared design/administration/function lexical ordering with retained whole queue; no outcome-direction selection.

design.population: Ambulant prepubescent DMD boys, able to walk at least 170 m; clinical/dystrophin/molecular diagnosis; no renal/hepatic insufficiency, wheelchair dependence, weight above 60 kg or planned surgery.
design.primary_missing_reason: Unable to walk 170 m because of gastroenteritis at four-month assessment of placebo phase; native flow locates child in glutamine-first sequence.
design.other_potentially_anabolic_cointerventio: None, including creatine, according to main. No training intervention described.
design.randomization: Computer-generated blocks of 6; central DRCD and AGEPS pharmacy independent of outcome evaluation; concealed numbered containers; code not opened until analyses completed.

preparation.active: L-glutamine compounded by AGEPS central pharmacy, Paris
preparation.schedule: Once each morning mixed with water or yogurt
preparation.packaging: Identical 5 g sachets; matched taste, odor and appearance; banana, caramel and aspartame flavoring. Main dispensed two-month supplies at months 0, 2, 5, 7.
preparation.protocol_quality: Single pharmaceutical-quality lot planned under pharmacy/GCP standards; no actual batch ID/purity assay supplied.
preparation.dose_weight_basis: Protocol/December 2005 parent form specify inclusion weight and fixed absolute amount throughout study; no source-supported recalculation imposed.
preparation.nutritional_contrast: Carbohydrate placebo rather than nitrogen-matched amino acids; full calorie equivalence and excipient quantities not established.
preparation.adherence: Returned used/unused sachets; similar between periods, no numerical rate given.
preparation.equivalence_limits: Source specifies L-isomer here; no automatic new alias, retail equivalence or identity to earlier source-labelled CINRG glutamine 0.6 g/kg/day.

analysis.primary: Change in comfortable walking speed over standardized 170 m course after 4 months of each treatment
analysis.model: Repeated-measures ANOVA assessing treatment/order/interaction; log or square-root transformations as needed; significance P < .05
analysis.missingness: No imputation described; primary flow29 analyzed, descriptive active-period n = 30/control-period n = 29; exact paired secondary n not reported.
analysis.planned_sample: 30 to detect 10% walking-speed increase, stated 80% power, alpha .05. Protocol explores unknown within-person correlation: required n = 37, 33, 30, 26, 22, 19 at correlations 0, .1, .2, .3, .4, .5; recruitment feasibility also informed n = 30. No new power computation.
analysis.multiplicity: No reported correction for multiple secondary endpoints or unplanned subgroup analyses.
analysis.carryover: One-month washout based on turnover rationale, no significant sequence effects on relative responses reported; absence of significance does not establish no carryover. FFM has order effect P = .001.

outcomes.format: Four-month period medians with Q1/Q3. Values describe periods within children, not independent arms or a reconstructed paired contrast.

function.name: walking speed
function.treatment_result: No significant improvement reported; no exactP orCI.

outcomes.work_power_limit: Protocol derives work/power from walking mass/distance/time, not direct muscle force or calorimetry. Unit/conversion notation preserved, not repaired or recalculated.

body_composition.name: BIA fat-free mass
body_composition.direction: Smaller increase with glutamine; nominal secondary pattern, not proof of muscle loss or mechanistic harm.

outcomes.measurement_limits: BIA fat-free mass includes water/connective tissue and does not measure muscle renewal. Urinary-creatinine mass assumes 1 g/day represents 20 kg muscle; lack of meat-free diet limits methylhistidine interpretation.

other_observations.interpretation: Within-cohort stability and family impressions are not randomized treatment effects; proposed placebo-response explanation is not established without untreated comparison.

exploratory_positive.explicit_author_label: Unplanned analysis in a small subgroup
exploratory_positive.reported_treatment_test: P < .05, variance analysis with logarithmic transformation
exploratory_positive.interpretation: Retain actual nominal treatment positive without erasing overall null. Not inferred merely from different within-arm significance. Does not prove subgroup specificity, synergy or confirmatory combination efficacy.

harms.main_claim: No significant side-effect-profile or biochemical differences; authors describe generally well tolerated.
harms.limits: Not powered as safety trial; no detailed severity table/numerical renal contrasts; excludes renal/hepatic insufficiency. No longer-term, universal or MVA safety claim.

prespecification.protocol_analysis: Primary completers of both periods; sequence/treatment/order comparisons using Student or Wilcoxon tests; no separate final SAP/amendment history retrieved.
prespecification.publication_difference: Repeated-measures ANOVA and transformations in main. 2-MWT not located in supplied protocol text, but in current registry/main.
prespecification.embedded_equations: DOC extraction leaves Equation.3 object placeholders; no claim to native equation/layout reading or independent recalculation.
prespecification.registration_before_first_participant: Unresolved because exact first-enrollment day is not supplied.
prespecification.ethics: Native statement 20 September 2004, meeting 15 September, project 2004/13, removes 7 July reservation. Parent form instead labels 7 July favorable opinion; not harmonized.

document_discrepancies: Main native Table2 power in watts versus main Methods/current registry kcal/s; protocol conversion notation not independently resolved.
Supplied parent form generic 20–30 g sachet wording versus main 5 g sachets; main weight-based preparation retained.
Protocol planned single dispensing per period, main dispensed two-month supplies.
Protocol completeness-based tests versus final ANOVA details; exact amendment history unavailable.
Parent form ethics date versus native favorable-opinion statement.

comparative_interpretation.disposition: Potential append/refinement of existing glutamine comparison, not new duplicate. Overall functional null with exploratory corticosteroid-subgroup positive and nominal body-composition differences retained.
comparative_interpretation.compensation_bar: Same function/exposure/duration/renewal/fidelity criteria as other candidates; BUBR1 mediation additionally required only for restoration claims.

scientific_summary: The four-month AGEPS L-glutamine DMD crossover did not establish overall functional benefit, but reported an actual nominal treatment positive in an unplanned five-boy corticosteroid subgroup. Body-composition direction, variable denominators and safety/planning limits remain explicit; no interaction, synergy or MVA benefit follows.
